facts.text: One girl got missed tonight. Grab a mince pie for the sleigh, we're eating on the way to Trelew.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Arthur never says this. No quote page for the film could be opened (Ranker would not load), and nothing in the Wikipedia plot matches it.
